Title: Ansible Fails waiting for privilege escalation on Ubuntu 26
Description:
I've slowly been moving my servers from Ubuntu 22 and 24 to 26 this year, and noticed my Ansible automation starts failing if I have password protection for sudo use:
$ ansible-playbook main.yml -K BECOME password: PLAY [Security] ******************************************************* TASK [Gathering Facts] *********************************************************************** fatal: [my-server.local]: FAILED! => msg: 'Timeout (12s) waiting for privilege escalation prompt: ' Apparently Ubuntu's been rewriting system utilities in Rust, and the sudo-rs version that ships on Ubuntu 26.04 has some incompatiblities with the sudo I've used on servers for 20+ years.
